concept: One continuous trip: PIT → California → Wisconsin → PIT. No backtracking.
routing_philosophy: Three one-way tickets, west then east. Never retrace steps.

options.name: The Allegiant Unicorn
options.tagline: The parents visit isn't a detour — it's the routing logic that unlocks a hidden nonstop to Door County
routing: ONE-WAY #1: PIT → SJC (connect through ORD/DEN, ~$150)
Santa Cruz 3-4 nights with James — Boardwalk, beach, redwoods, Monterey/Carmel day trip (45 min)
ONE-WAY #2: SJC → SNA (Southwest nonstop, 1hr 20min, ~$77)
Irvine 1-2 nights with parents — not a detour, it's how you get to SNA
ONE-WAY #3: SNA → ATW nonstop (Allegiant, NEW route launched May 2026, ~$79, departs 10:55am, 3hr 49min)
Drive ATW → Door County (1.5 hours)
Door County 3-4 nights — supper clubs, fish boils, lighthouses
ONE-WAY #4: Drive Door County → GRB (45 min), fly GRB → PIT (connect through ORD, ~$100-160)
options.estimated_flight_cost: $400-550 total for 3 people's worth of one-ways (not per person — these are cheap legs)
options.actual_per_person_estimate: $400-550 per person for all 4 flight legs combined
why_this_is_clever: SNA → ATW is a brand new Allegiant nonstop (launched May 2026) that almost nobody knows about yet
The parents visit in Irvine goes from 'nice-to-have' to 'the routing move that unlocks a nonstop to Door County's backyard'
ATW is only 1.5 hours from Door County vs. 3 hours from MKE or 4 from ORD
10:55am departure from SNA is a perfect flight time — not early, not late
You never fly back to PIT until you're done with everything
Southwest SJC→SNA has free bags, no change fees, and tons of schedule options
options.critical_constraint: Allegiant SNA→ATW is ONCE PER WEEK. Must check which day and align Door County dates to it. If it doesn't align, fall back to Option B.

family_match.niki: See James (rare chance), see parents (efficient), Monterey sushi, coastal vibes all week
family_match.carissa: Carmel charm, Door County supper clubs are her dream. The SNA→ATW leg is nonstop! Only PIT→SJC requires a connection.
family_match.ashi: Boardwalk, Capitola boutiques, Carmel galleries, then fish boils — a summer highlight reel

options.name: The United Express (Reliable Fallback)
options.tagline: 8 daily nonstops SFO→ORD means you pick the perfect flight time
routing: ONE-WAY #1: PIT → SJC (connect, ~$150)
Santa Cruz 3-4 nights with James + Monterey/Carmel day trip
ONE-WAY #2: SFO → ORD nonstop (United, 8 daily flights, ~$157, pick a 10am-2pm departure, 4hr 35min)
Drive ORD → Door County (4 hours — exactly your max, but it's a straight shot up I-94/I-43 through pretty Wisconsin)
Door County 3-4 nights
ONE-WAY #3: Drive Door County → GRB (45 min), fly GRB → PIT (connect through ORD, ~$100-160). OR drive back to ORD (4hrs) and fly ORD → PIT nonstop (~$100, Carissa gets her direct flight home)
options.estimated_per_person: $350-470 per person for all flight legs
why_this_is_good: SFO→ORD is one of the most competitive routes in the US — 8+ United nonstops daily, great prices
Maximum schedule flexibility — any day, many times
The ORD→PIT nonstop home is Carissa's preferred direct flight ending
No dependency on a once-per-week Allegiant schedule
tradeoff: Skips Irvine parents (save for another trip)
ORD → Door County is 4 hours driving (at the max)
Need to get from Santa Cruz area to SFO (30 min drive or Caltrain/bus)

options.name: The United Express + Chicago Roos
options.tagline: Same as B but add a night in Chicago to see the Roos and break up the drive
routing: ONE-WAY #1: PIT → SJC (connect, ~$150)
Santa Cruz 3-4 nights with James + Monterey/Carmel day trip
ONE-WAY #2: SFO → ORD nonstop (United, ~$157)
Chicago 1 night — dinner with the Roos, sleep
Drive ORD area → Door County next morning (4 hours, but fresh and with coffee stops)
Door County 3-4 nights
Drive Door County → GRB (45 min), fly GRB → PIT (connect through ORD)
options.why_variant: The Roos visit becomes natural — you're literally passing through Chicago. No detour.
options.tradeoff: Adds a night and you've been to Chicago recently — only do this if the Roos are genuinely a priority

options.name: The Southwest Double-Nonstop
options.tagline: Southwest nonstop SJC→MDW, then MDW area to Door County
routing: ONE-WAY #1: PIT → SJC (connect, ~$150)
Santa Cruz 3-4 nights with James + Monterey/Carmel day trip
ONE-WAY #2: SJC → MDW nonstop (Southwest, ~$134, 4hr 8min)
Drive MDW → Door County (4 hours) or overnight in Chicago area first
Door County 3-4 nights
Drive to GRB or MKE, fly home to PIT
why: Southwest = free bags, no change fees, good for families
SJC departure means no need to get to SFO
watch_out: SJC→MDW flight times may be bad — earliest is 6:10am (too early), latest is 11pm (red eye). Need to check if there's a midday option.
If only early/late times available, this option breaks the 'no bad flight times' constraint

highlights: Visit James (rare opportunity — he's only there until August)
Santa Cruz Beach Boardwalk — free entry, rides, Friday night movies on the beach
Henry Cowell Redwoods — easy redwood hiking 15 min from town
Downtown Santa Cruz — good boba scene for Ashi, indie coffee shops
Capitola Village (10 min south) — colorful beachfront cottages, boutiques, very aesthetic
Natural Bridges State Beach — tide pools, iconic rock arch
santa_cruz.temp_F: 60-72 — perfect, never hot, foggy mornings burn off

highlights: Monterey Bay Aquarium — world-class, Ashi would love it
Crystal Fish sushi — possibly the best sushi on the Monterey Peninsula
Akaoni — locals say best sushi in town
Carmel-by-the-Sea — fairy-tale downtown, boutique shops, galleries, white sand beach
Point Lobos — stunning coastal nature reserve, easy walks
monterey_carmel_day_trip.food_note: Not SF/Seattle level for Japanese food, but Crystal Fish and Akaoni are genuinely good. The seafood is excellent — fresh from Monterey Bay.

supper_clubs_for_carissa: Nightingale Supper Club (Sturgeon Bay, since 1913) — steaks, prime rib, old-fashioneds, wood and tradition
The Mill Supper Club (Sturgeon Bay, since 1930) — German + American, schnitzel to steaks
Sister Bay Bowl and Supper Club (since 1958) — 'Best Fish Fry' and 'Best Old Fashioned' in Door County
The English Inn — beef wellington, pistachio-encrusted halibut, garden patio
The Log Den (Egg Harbor) — hand-carved log building, five generations of family
must_do: Fish boil — dramatic spectator cooking event unique to Door County, whitefish + potatoes
door_county_leg_details.food_note: Not a sushi/omakase destination — this leg is about supper clubs, fish boils, and Wisconsin comfort. That's the point: the California leg covers the foodie hits, Door County covers the vibe.

recommendation.top_pick: Option A (Allegiant Unicorn) IF the once-per-week schedule aligns with ~Aug 7 Door County dates
recommendation.reliable_pick: Option B (United Express) if Allegiant doesn't align — you can't beat 8 daily SFO→ORD nonstops for flexibility
recommendation.next_step: Check Allegiant.com for the specific day of week SNA→ATW operates, and whether it lands you in Door County around Aug 7. If yes, book it. If no, go with Option B.

eliminated_from_previous_round.irvine_as_primary_destination: Not a destination trip — but works brilliantly as routing logic in Option A
